methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: Roanoke College launches WorkAI Lab to prepare leaders for new era of technology - Roanoke College
signals.signal_reading: Roanoke College's WorkAI Lab represents intentional capability-building in a non-metro region, creating potential for distributed deep fluency if the model scales beyond a single institution to regional peer networks.

signals.title: New partnership between VCU and AI Ready RVA aims to boost AI education, innovation and community impact - VCU News
signals.signal_reading: The VCU-AI Ready RVA partnership signals metro regions outside NoVA building infrastructure for broad community AI education, potentially distributing capability if it reaches beyond academic institutions into workforce development.

signals.title: Virginia Beach schools bring ChatGPT under division oversight as AI use grows - 13newsnow.com
signals.signal_reading: Virginia Beach schools bringing ChatGPT under division oversight indicates platform-based AI adoption spreading to public institutions, creating broad but shallow distribution where tools are used without deep technical capability development.

signals.title: Norfolk could get AI assist for non-emergency calls - WAVY.com
signals.signal_reading: Norfolk's AI dispatcher for non-emergency calls exemplifies procurement-driven shallow adoption—purchasing turnkey solutions rather than building internal AI capability, distributing access but not expertise.

signals.title: McLean data center power-focused startup to be acquired for $232.28M
signals.signal_reading: A $232M McLean data center acquisition reinforces NoVA's concentration of AI infrastructure capital and technical expertise, deepening the specialized knowledge cluster without mechanisms for geographic distribution to other Virginia regions.
